issues.element: Apply button beside the search field: enabled state is now a light-grey fill with dark text, which reads as a disabled button on a near-black UI (on the error screen the actually-disabled Apply is dark with grey text, so the two states look inverted)
issues.fix: Render enabled Apply like Refresh (lifted grey surface, white bold text, visible border); keep disabled as dim text on the base surface. Or make it the same white-fill primary as Retry so one primary style exists.

issues.element: Disabled controls (Clear filters with no active filters, Previous on Requests page 1, Refresh while loading) use a lifted grey surface — the same surface that marks the selected pill/tab — so disabled and selected share one visual cue; on Requests the disabled Previous is more visible than the enabled Next
issues.fix: Disabled = no fill, transparent border, ~40% text; reserve the lifted grey surface for selected/pressed only; enabled secondary buttons get a 1px border on the base surface.

issues.element: Clear filters and Refresh collapse to icon-only 32px squares at the right of the time-range row; a bare × in a box reads as close/dismiss, not clear filters
issues.fix: Keep text labels down to 1024 (wrap the action pair onto the search row instead), or at minimum use a filter-off icon with a tooltip/aria-label and keep the 'Clear filters' word at 1024+.

issues.element: 'Current bucket: hour' sits ~8px from the Daily pill group and crowds it, with Clear filters/Refresh jammed to its right (r13 had it right-aligned with clear space)
issues.fix: Right-align the bucket readout with the action pair and give it at least the 16px group gap; hide it below 1440 as at 1366.

issues.element: Search placeholder clipped ('Model or request referenc') because the search field shrinks to share a row with Apply and three selects
issues.fix: At <=1024 put search + Apply on its own full-width row and the three selects on the next row (as the reference does), or shorten the placeholder to 'Model or request ID'.

issues.element: Mobile view tabs render as a 3x2 grid of ~12px labels (smaller than r13's ~13px); at 320 'Tokens & Cache' and 'Last 24 hours' wrap to two lines; unselected tabs have no outline so the grid reads as text, not a segmented control
issues.fix: Use a single horizontally scrolling segmented row (or a select) at <600px with 13px labels and 44px height; keep unselected segments inside one bordered track so they read as tappable.

issues.element: No chart on the first screen at phone/tablet-portrait sizes: eight KPI tiles (2 columns, ~130px each) push the Usage trend below the fold
issues.fix: At <768 show KPIs as a compact 2-column number list without sparklines (or a horizontally scrolling strip) so the primary chart starts within the first screen.

issues.element: Flat-series KPIs (Failed events, Cache-write, Reasoning, Priced/Unpriced events) now draw a full-width hairline; at 390 it reads as a divider or input underline, not a sparkline
issues.fix: Draw flat series with the same height box and endpoint dots as other sparklines, or drop the line and show 'No change' text in grey.

issues.element: Per-row 'Details' buttons are ~28px tall at 1440 and ~24px at 2293 and the column header repeats 'Details'
issues.fix: Make the row clickable (with hover surface) plus a 32px+ Details button; drop or blank the 'Details' column header.

issues.element: Header says '128 retained events' while the page shows 3 rows and 'Page 1' with no total pages or range
issues.fix: Show 'Rows 1–3 of 128' (or 'Page 1 of N') beside Previous/Next.

issues.element: Time-range pills, bucket pills, outcome filter and search remain fully active on Model Rates although the note says these are current configured rates, not historical
issues.fix: Disable (with a tooltip 'Rates are not time-based') or hide time range, bucket and outcome controls on this tab; keep only provider/model filters.

issues.element: Numeric rate columns are spread far right with a large dead gap after Billing model, and 'Rate details' is a bare text disclosure triangle
issues.fix: Cap table width or give text columns the slack; style 'Rate details' as a small bordered disclosure button consistent with Details on Requests.

issues.element: Empty-state card tells the user to 'Choose a longer range' but offers no action; below it eight tiles of 0/Unavailable repeat the emptiness
issues.fix: Add an inline 'Show last 7 days' button in the empty card; collapse the KPI grid to a single muted row or hide it.

issues.element: 'Unavailable' KPI values use a regular-weight larger grey face while numeric values are bold white, so the tile row has two value styles
issues.fix: Keep the value slot's size/weight and set 'Unavailable' in the secondary grey at the same weight, or use an em dash with 'Unavailable' as the caption.

issues.element: 'View data table' disclosures remain under charts that state 'No measured values in this interval', inviting a click into an empty table
issues.fix: Hide or disable 'View data table' when the series has no measured points.

issues.element: Retry (white fill) and toolbar Refresh (grey lifted) do the same thing in two styles; Apply has a third primary style; tabs and range pills stay enabled while the dataset is missing
issues.fix: Keep Retry as the single primary action, disable Refresh/Apply/range pills while in the error state, and use one primary-button style across Apply and Retry.

issues.element: Refresh is disabled while loading but Apply, range and bucket pills remain enabled; skeleton tiles are static boxes with no progress motion; at 390 the header refresh icon is highlighted as if pressed
issues.fix: Disable or mark busy (aria-busy) all query controls together during loading, add a subtle shimmer or spinner on 'Loading analytics…', and do not show the header refresh in a pressed state.

issues.element: Toolbar pills, KPI labels and chart axis labels stay at ~11px across a 3440px-wide canvas, so the controls occupy only the left third and look undersized against a 1600px-tall chart
issues.fix: Cap the content width (e.g. 2400px) or step the UI scale up one notch above 2560px so controls and labels keep proportion with the chart.

regressions: Apply button: r13 dark lifted surface with white bold text (clearly enabled) -> r14 light-grey fill with dark text, which reads as disabled on every data screen and size.
Mobile view-tab labels at 390/320 shrank from ~13px to ~12px, reducing readability of the primary navigation on phones.
At 1440 'Current bucket: hour' moved from a right-aligned position with clear space to directly abutting the Daily pill group, crowding the toolbar row.
Flat-series KPIs replaced the 'Flat trend' text with a full-width hairline that at 390 reads as a divider/underline rather than a sparkline.
reference_gaps: Reference keeps 'Clear all' and 'Refresh' as labelled buttons at all desktop widths; Prox collapses them to icon-only ×/refresh squares at 1280 and below.

Reference search spans its own full-width row with filters on a separate equal-width row and filters apply live; Prox squeezes search + an extra Apply button + three selects into one row, which clips the placeholder at 768-1024.
Reference shows refresh/auto-refresh status next to Refresh (e.g. '(6s)'); Prox shows only an 'Updated:' timestamp in the header, away from the Refresh control.
Reference offers a 'Custom' range segment and finer bucket sizes (1 Min / 15 Min) with clearly greyed disabled segments; Prox has no custom range and no visible disabled segment styling.
Reference keeps the segmented groups as one horizontal row with bordered tracks at all widths; Prox's mobile tabs become an unbordered 3x2 grid that loses the segmented-pill read.

Reference has 'Show advanced filters' as a labelled toggle; Prox has no advanced-filter affordance (fine if not needed, but the outcome/provider/model selects use native browser chevrons rather than the reference's styled dropdowns).
